explanation.summary: RIKELEKTRO AS (991 320 164), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2007-05-10; address Sørlifjellet 4, 1788 HALDEN, Norge. Main industry is 43.210 Elektrisk installasjonsarbeid; 58 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Leif Kim André Eriksen; Board chair: Kjetil Bjerkland; Auditor: VAAK REVISJON OG RÅDGIVNING AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 121.41 m, operating profit NOK 4.98 m, net profit NOK 4.12 m, equity NOK 12.78 m, total assets NOK 29.74 m. Website https://www.rikelektro.no is verified: the org number appears on the page.
